The 1943–44 season was [[List of Real Madrid CF seasons|Real Madrid Club de Fútbol's 41st season]] in existence and the club's [[La Liga|12th consecutive season]] in the top flight of Spanish football.

==Summary==
A new Executive Board arrived on 11 September 1943, and the club appointed Santiago Bernabéu as its new president.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://hemeroteca.abc.es/nav/Navigate.exe/hemeroteca/madrid/abc/1943/09/16/015.html |title=Real Madrid New Executive Board |accessdate=23 November 2020 |date=16 September 1943 |work=ABC|location=Spain|language=Spanish}}</ref> The squad finished seventh in the league, 12 points below champions Valencia.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.cac.es/es/info/prensa/noticias/sabias-que-hoy-hace-70-anos-el-valencia-cf-conquisto-su-primer-titulo-de-liga.html|title=Valencia 1944|publisher=cac.es|date=2 April 2014|accessdate=30 November 2020}}</ref> in the first season of Ramon Encinas as head coach. On 16 July 1944, the club played the only match in its history against UD Melilla (until 2018).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.abc.es/deportes/real-madrid/abci-odisea-viaje-real-madrid-melilla-1944-201810310308_noticia.html|work=ABC|location=Spain|title=The Odissey of Real Madrid in its Trip to Melilla|date=20 November 2018|accessdate=20 November 2020}}</ref> After 11 years in the club, midfielder Sauto announced his retirement.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.marca.com/claro-mx/futbol-internacional/la-liga/2017/04/16/58f37f21468aeb50058b4573.html|title=Sauto, The Mexican who played in Real Madrid|work=Marca|location=Spain|date=24 October 2020|accessdate=2 December 2020|language=Spanish}}</ref> In the Copa del Generalísimo, the squad was eliminated in the round of 16 by underdogs Granada CF after being shockingly defeated 0–2 in Madrid.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://as.com/futbol/2019/10/02/primera/1570030546_917486.html|title=Granada To Conquer Bernabeu|publisher=as.com|date=2 October 2019|accessdate=2 December 2020}}</ref>
